body:
### Summary

Installing `annotated-types==0.8.0` with `--link-mode=clone` consistently fails on a Windows ReFS Dev Drive with `ERROR_MORE_DATA` (`0x800700EA`).

Both the uv cache and the virtual environment reside on the same ReFS volume.

The issue is reproducible with both an existing cache and a newly created cache. Installing the same package with `--link-mode=copy` succeeds.

### Environment

- **uv:** `0.13.9 (6b2d39dcc 2026-11-17 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)`
- **Python:** CPython 3.15.2
- **OS:** Windows 11, build 26300
- **Architecture:** AMD64
- **Shell:** PowerShell 7.7.0
- **File system:** ReFS 3.14 (Dev Drive)
- **Cluster size:** 4096 bytes

### Steps to reproduce

On a ReFS Dev Drive (mounted as `V:` in this example), run the following commands using a previously unused cache directory and virtual environment:

```powershell
uv venv V:\uv-repro\new-env --python 3.15

uv pip install annotated-types==0.8.0 `
    --python V:\uv-repro\new-env\Scripts\python.exe `
    --cache-dir V:\uv-repro\fresh-cache `
    --link-mode=clone `
    --no-deps -vv
```

### Expected behavior

The package should be installed successfully using block cloning.

### Actual behavior

Dependency resolution and wheel preparation succeed, but installation fails when cloning `annotated_types/test_cases.py`:

```text
error: Failed to install: annotated_types-0.8.0-py3-none-any.whl (annotated-types==0.8.0)
  cause: Failed to clone `V:\uv-repro\fresh-cache\archive-v0\m7RAYF3xB4ouNmbR\annotated_types\test_cases.py` to
         `V:\uv-repro\new-env\Lib\site-packages\annotated_types\test_cases.py`
  cause: 有更多数据可用。 (os error -2147024662)
```

The localized error message corresponds to `ERROR_MORE_DATA` (HRESULT `0x800700EA`, Win32 error 234).

### Control experiment

Using the same cached wheel and a separate virtual environment, installation succeeds with `--link-mode=copy`:

```powershell
uv venv V:\uv-repro\copy-env --python 3.15

uv pip install annotated-types==0.8.0 `
    --python V:\uv-repro\copy-env\Scripts\python.exe `
    --cache-dir V:\uv-repro\fresh-cache `
    --link-mode=copy `
    --offline --no-deps -vv
```

Output:

```text
Installed 1 package in 14ms
 + annotated-types==0.8.0
```

### Additional findings

| Cache | Link mode | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Existing cache | `clone` | Failed |
| Newly created cache | `clone` | Failed |
| Newly created cache | `copy` | Succeeded |

Both failed installations consistently report the same file and error code.

The affected file, `annotated_types/test_cases.py`, has a logical size of 6310 bytes. On the ReFS volume with a cluster size of 4096 bytes, it occupies two non-contiguous, single-cluster extents.

Querying its extents in the newly created cache using `fsutil file queryExtentsAndRefCounts` produces the following results (column names translated into English):

```text
VCN: 0x0  Clusters: 0x1  LCN: 0x187e02  Ref: 0x1
VCN: 0x1  Clusters: 0x1  LCN: 0x187604  Ref: 0x1
```

Native Windows block cloning was also tested independently using Robocopy, with `/NOCLONE` as a control, and worked as expected on the same volume.

The underlying cause has not been identified. Reproduction has so far been confirmed on the environment described above.
title: `--link-mode=clone` fails with ERROR_MORE_DATA on Windows ReFS Dev Drive
